title: Deep Recon
description: A third resource, moving alongside builders and cargo: intel. Get enough of it to the forward outpost to call the area scouted.

narrative.intro: Command got its wish: a third route type. Builders and cargo aren't the only thing that moves through a network — intelligence does too, and it needs its own dedicated route. Get 6 intel reports to the forward outpost, keep the network a single connected tree, and don't let route budget go to something you don't need this time.
narrative.outro: Three resource types sharing one network and never interfering with each other — that's the whole point of routes being typed. Intel didn't compete with cargo for capacity because they were never on the same route. Scouts found something else out there worth a look: a site that grows on its own.

goals.description: Deliver at least 6 intel to the Forward Outpost.
No loops: the network must stay a tree.
